content: FlexRay Interface fan-out support The redundant transmis- sion in the FlexRay Interface in the static segment is described by • one FlexrayFrameTriggering on each PhysicalChannel • both FlexrayFrameTriggering s refer to the same FlexrayFrame with the same Pdu • each FlexrayFrameTriggering aggregates the same number of FlexrayAbsolutelyScheduledTiming s • for every FlexrayAbsolutelyScheduledTiming on one PhysicalChan- nel a corresponding FlexrayAbsolutelyScheduledTiming with identical values shall be defined on the other PhysicalChannel
